projects.title: OT Offline Asset Extractor
projects.description: Collaborated with a team of five students to design, build and test a command line asset extraction tool that takes in a backup file type (VEEAM, ACRONIS, Windows) and outputs a JSON file with all software installed alongside their name, version number, and vendor. Developed modules written in C++ that extract relevant data from the Windows registry, Fedora, and CentOS files.

projects.title: Wireless Node Sensor
projects.description: Teamed up with a partner to design, simulate, and test a solar-powered temperature sensor that conserves energy during nighttime. Incorporated Arduino timers with a photosensor into the design to check that there is light, if no light is detected the system enters deep sleep mode. Developed a user-friendly GUI using the Processing language to facilitate product usage. Integrated Bluetooth technology to send data from the sensors to the GUI.
